title: Netcode: add protocol version field + connect handshake version check
description: Serialization is hand-rolled byte packing with NO version field (net.h header: type/player_id/seq/ack/ack_bits). A client/server packet-format mismatch corrupts silently. Add a protocol version constant, carry it in PKT_CONNECT_REQUEST/ACCEPT, and reject mismatched clients with a clear disconnect reason. FOUNDATION: land this before features add new packets so format drift is caught, not silently corrupting. Effort S.

title: World persistence (save/load chunks to disk)
description: Worlds are seed-only and reset every session, including player block edits. Serialize modified chunks + player state to disk on the server and reload on startup. Enables base building.

title: Ores and minerals (coal/iron/gold/diamond) with depth-based worldgen
description: All stone is identical. Add ore block types and distribute them in worldgen by depth (coal common shallow, diamond rare deep) using deterministic noise so it is unit-testable. Foundation for crafting/tools progression.
close_reason: Implemented: 4 ore types, depth-based deterministic worldgen distribution, textures, unit tests (12/12 pass). Committed on feat/ores.

title: Day/night cycle with time-gated mob spawning
description: No time-of-day exists; lighting is static and mobs spawn at all times. Add a server-authoritative world time clock, broadcast it to clients, drive sky/sun brightness in the renderer, and gate hostile mob spawning to night/darkness. Foundational for atmosphere and survival pacing.

title: Server: validate block edits against authoritative server world
description: Server trusts client-claimed block id on break (net.h note: 'Server has no world today, so it trusts the client'). The server DOES keep a headless world for mobs — consult it to validate break target identity and reach, closing the main cheat/desync gap. Effort M.

title: Netcode: reliable message fragmentation for payloads >256B
description: RELIABLE_MAX_PAYLOAD is 256B (reliable.h). Larger reliable messages (future inventory/crafting/chunk sync) cannot be sent. Add fragment headers (frag_id/total) and reassembly so reliable payloads up to MTU work. Effort M.

title: Netcode: central bounds-checked packet codec (cursor read/write)
description: Every packet has inline net_write_*/net_read_* with manual offsets; offset bugs propagate and there is no bounds checking. Add a NetCursor {buf,off,limit} with codec_write/read_* that assert against limit. Refactor existing packet builders onto it. Reduces serialization bugs as packet types grow. Effort M.

title: Netcode: sequence + dedup for unreliable broadcasts (WORLD_STATE/MOB_STATE)
description: PKT_WORLD_STATE and PKT_MOB_STATE are sent unreliable with no sequence number; an out-of-order/late packet applies stale positions over newer ones (visible rubber-banding). Add a per-stream seq to these broadcasts and have the client discard packets older than the last applied. Effort M.

title: Fall damage and environmental damage (drowning, lava)
description: Player takes no fall/drown/lava damage. Add server-side fall-distance damage, an oxygen/drowning timer underwater, and lava contact damage. Builds on existing health system.

title: Hunger and food system
description: No resource scarcity. Add a hunger bar, saturation decay tied to activity, food items that restore hunger, and starvation/regen effects. Server-authoritative.

title: Crafting system (recipes + crafting UI)
description: No way to combine items. Add a recipe table, server-validated crafting, and a crafting grid UI. Depends on non-block item types from tools.

title: Tools (pickaxe/shovel/axe) with durability and mining speed
description: Inventory only holds blocks. Introduce non-block item types (tools), per-tool mining speed multipliers vs block categories, and durability wear. Depends on block hardness.

title: Block hardness and timed mining
description: Blocks break instantly. Add per-block hardness and a mining-progress model so breaking takes time; server validates. Prereq for tools mattering.

title: Netcode: spatial interest culling for broadcasts
description: All players/mobs are broadcast to all clients regardless of distance. Add per-client interest sets (e.g. within N blocks) so distant entity updates are not sent. Enables scaling player/mob counts. Effort L.

title: Netcode: delta/quantized encoding for world state broadcasts
description: PKT_WORLD_STATE sends full float positions for every player every 20Hz tick (~21B/player). At 32 players that is ~13.6KB/s/client. Quantize/delta-encode positions to cut bandwidth. Effort M.

title: Tech debt: implement UI input handler
description: ui.c:687 has a stubbed UI input handler (mouse-based UI interaction). Needed for crafting/inventory screens.

title: Tech debt: wire agent hotbar snapshot from client.inventory
description: main.c:534-536 hardcodes the agent-mode hotbar snapshot to 0 instead of reading client.inventory. Wire it through so agent/automation sees real inventory state.

title: Mob variety (skeleton, creeper) and loot drops
description: Only zombies exist and mobs drop nothing. Add additional hostile mob types with distinct AI (ranged skeleton, exploding creeper) and item drops on death. Depends on item-drop mechanics.

title: Armor system
description: All damage is equal. Add armor item types, equipment slots, and damage reduction. Depends on crafting and non-block items.

title: Death and respawn polish (death screen, item drop)
description: Health can reach zero but death is a non-event. Add a death screen, drop inventory on death, and respawn at spawn point with grace period.

title: Biome system
description: All terrain looks the same. Add a biome noise layer selecting surface blocks, tree density, and terrain shaping (plains/forest/desert/mountains). Build on existing worldgen noise.
